title: Appliance Vibration Fault Early-Warning
dataSources: Mould risk (`mould:risk`), crack meters (`crackmeter:reading`), HVAC filter life (`hvacfilter:life`), structural tilt (`structural:tilt`).
app: Building-health sensors — indoor humidity / mould-risk monitors, crack and tilt meters, HVAC filter-life trackers, and damp sensors — streamed to Splunk HEC via MQTT and ESPHome.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=structural:tilt event=vibration
| timechart span=1h avg(vibration_rms) as vib by appliance
| eventstats avg(vib) as base, stdev(vib) as sd by appliance
| eval fault=if(vib>base+3*sd,1,0)
description: Watches vibration on big appliances like the washing machine for a jump that can precede a bearing failure.
value: Rising vibration is an early mechanical warning; catching it can turn a catastrophic failure into a cheap repair.
implementation: Ingest appliance vibration into `index=personal`; alert on abnormal vibration.
visualization: Time chart of appliance vibration with fault threshold.
grandmaExplanation: It listens to big appliances shaking and warns of a jump that can mean a part is about to fail.
